title: Poster sheet
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y3 lesson 6 (Poster sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 6: Staying healthy: hand washing, teeth and germs. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Stopping germs
points: Catch it, bin it, kill it
Wash hands with soap for 20 seconds

panels.title: Teeth
points: Brush twice a day for 2 minutes

box.title: Four rules, with words and pictures of objects (soap, tissue, bin, toothbrush). No people.

keywords.def: a tiny living thing that can cause illness
pass from one place or person to another
a sticky layer of germs on teeth

questions.q: Put in order: rinse, wet, soap, dry, rub for 20 seconds.
questions.a: Wet, soap, rub for 20 seconds, rinse, dry.
For example: sneezes and dirty hands.

questions.q: Core: Make a 'Stop the germs' poster with four rules (words and pictures of objects, no people).
questions.a: Four rules: wash hands, catch sneezes, brush teeth, do not share cups.

questions.q: Extend: With a grown-up, try the pepper and soap experiment and write what happened.
questions.a: The pepper moved away from the soap.

questions.q: Stretch: Explain how wudu helps keep us clean.
questions.a: We wash our hands, mouth, nose, face, arms and feet several times a day.

questions.q: You need to sneeze. Best thing to do?
options: Catch it in a tissue, bin it, wash hands
questions.a: B) Catch it in a tissue, bin it, wash hands. Catch it, bin it, kill it stops germs reaching hands and surfaces.

questions.q: Plaque is... A) a toothbrush B) a sticky layer of germs on teeth C) a type of food
questions.a: B) a sticky layer of germs on teeth
options: A sticky layer of germs on teeth

questions.q: Big question: after a sneeze into your hand and touching the fridge, where are the germs?
questions.a: On your hand and the fridge handle.
